other_conditions: Must be a construction worker registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board
Eligibility limited to two children (son or daughter) of the registered worker
Children must be admitted to courses run by the Skill University or an affiliated institution
Age limit for children is a maximum of 30 years, with no age limit if the child is handicapped
Assistance is limited to the first trial in the academic year; a student who fails the same standard/class is not eligible for a second aid for that standard/class
benefits_summary: Full course fee reimbursed (entire fee for courses ≤1 year; fees reimbursed annually for courses >1 year)
